features: Large Terrace off Main Barrel-Vaulted Bedroom
Underfloor Heating Included in Service Charge
Great Transport Links Including Elizabeth Line
description_html:
Bright 2-bedroom dual aspect apartment over 5th, 6th & 7 floors with view of the Shard. Type M3A. 2 full height width floor to ceiling sliding door/windows leading to a south facing balcony/fire exit. A large terrace off the main barrel-vaulted bedroom, with views of the sunset. Built-in wardrobes. Beautiful wood staircases to each floor. Picture windows top of the staircase landing. Refurbished throughout in sympathy to the original design. Dining area adjoining the kitchen. Underfloor heating included in the service charge. Several lifts. Use of residents’ gardens. 24hr car park attendants can hold keys and receive packages. Car parking and bike storage by separate negotiation with the City of London. Designed by the renowned architects Chamberlin, Powell & Bon, the Grade II-listed Barbican Estate includes the Barbican Arts Centre, cinemas, art gallery, concert hall, theatre, restaurants, bars and cafes. Waitrose, Marks & Spencer and Tesco are close at hand. The Barbican is perfectly located for the Elizabeth Line, with both Farringdon and Liverpool Street stations only a short walk away. Also in close proximity to the various lines at underground stations Barbican, St. Paul’s, and Moorgate. No onward chain.
Service Charge: Estimated: £7,490 01/04/26 to 31/03/27
Lease: Extended 1st July 2196
Ground Rent: Peppercorn
